title: Exquisite Juicy British Lamb Spotted Dick
description: A traditional British dish featuring charred, juicy lamb, served with couscous and spices, made in an ayurvedic-sattvic friendly way.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, char-grill-yang spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until it is charred and cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat a couple of tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
To serve, place the grilled lamb on top of the couscous, then spoon the onion and garlic mixture over the top.
